notes: Edit severity, thresholds or enabled here. No code change needed. Rules with required=true must return a result on every live run; a missing result is treated as BLOCKED. Unmapped columns turn a check MANUAL_REQUIRED at its severity (blocks release when CRITICAL or HIGH). Overlapping legacy checks are kept but disabled.
marquee: Release rule: a CRITICAL or HIGH check that fails, is Manual or is Blocked stops the release. WARNING and INFO go in the release notes.
Before calling a failure a code issue, check upstream: MDM mapping, projections and universe, SA, then POS.
Save your setup after mapping: inputs are cleared when the app restarts.
